ns2:course.label: Spatial Epidemiology
ns2:course.description: (VP 460) Patterns of health and disease in place and time; application of geographic information systems; analysis of time-space relations; clusters and diffusion of disease; geogrpahic epidemiology of selected infectious and noninfectious diseases. Same as CHLH 560, and GEOG 560. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CHLH 560 or equivalent, or VP 650 or VP 517 or equivalent; VP 524 or SOC 485 or equivalent.
